item: Calendar feed store: three swallowed exceptions are logged through the scrubbing sink (R386)
summary: The event_imports mirror failure in _save_json, a verification that raised and the failed ladder-attempt write in verify_due_feeds, and an auto-import failure now log through log_failure with the feed id and the scrubbed exception, never the feed URL or its credentials; tallies and behaviour unchanged. Red-before: with the attempt write failing the same never-checked feed is picked again by the next pass (reproduced, not inferred). The _save_json site is narrower than first stated: sync_imports logs its own database errors, so only failures before it can start were silent.
